protocol:
1. A sample is retrieved from a microcentrifuge tube stored in a lime green ice bucket.
2. The liquid sample is aspirated from the tube using a pipette.
3. The sample is dispensed from the pipette into a well of an E-Gel EX Invitrogen precast agarose gel cassette.
4. Additional samples are sequentially loaded into the remaining wells of the E-Gel EX cassette using the same pipetting technique.
5. The loaded E-Gel EX cassette is inserted into the E-Gel Power Snap Electrophoresis Device.
6. The lid of the E-Gel Power Snap device is closed.
7. An electrophoresis program is initiated on the device's touchscreen, starting a 10-minute run.
